cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.

mechanism: A presides over reconciliation as its only competent organizer and corrects requests into convenient boundaries.
confusable: Healthy mutual boundaries differ from A teaching B how repair must work for A's comfort.
comparison: Dinner timing contains upset; a weekend plan redirects difficult speech into a controlled written channel.
seedUse: Retain the seeds' concrete restrictions while showing A correcting the process throughout.
